description: TXN-MULTI, failure admitting the second file. Process b holds the second file open exclusively. Process a BeginTrans on main, updates T row 1, then tries ws.OpenDatabase of the second file (shared) with Errors before/after, updates T row 64, and CommitTrans (Errors before/after). b then closes; a opens the second file; b finally reads main row 1 and row 64 from its own fresh open. Asks whether the refused admission ends or damages the level and which changes are committed.
